failure_summary.description: Calls omitted or mis-mapped filters, constraints, or parameter placement despite the endpoint schemas.
Some calls used provider descriptions or shortened labels instead of the exact listed identifier, or selected unsuitable endpoints.
Some responses omitted requested calls, duplicated or bundled outcomes, or fanned out to redundant providers.
Some responses contained malformed JSON or bundled distinct calls into one object.

patch.reasoning: The skill already gives detailed argument-mapping, minimal-call-set, and JSON-validation rules, so repeating those would add little. The recurring tool-name failures suggest clarifying how to identify the canonical tool name in the listing.

edits.target: - Treat endpoint eligibility as a gate: confirm the endpoint's own operation and schema support the requested result kind and granularity, and can represent every compatible explicit qualifier. A topical neighbor or broader operation is not sufficient. A named provider or source is a hard constraint for that outcome; do not fulfill or supplement it with another provider when a fitting named-source endpoint exists.
edits.content: - Copy the tool identifier exactly from the listing's `### Provider: API` heading. Do not substitute the provider description, the provider name alone, or a paraphrased endpoint label; preserve the listed provider and endpoint names together.
